about.mission: We serve our customers with integrity, lead with professionalism, and deliver solutions that have a real impact.
story: Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, Yaron Engineering PLC was established with a bold and forward-looking vision: to become the leading ICT and Telecom consulting and system integration firm in Ethiopia and the greater East African region.

Since inception, Yaron Engineering has successfully delivered more than 30 high-impact projects for more than 40 clients across government institutions, enterprises, NGOs and financial organizations. That growth is built on a reputation for technical excellence, reliability and results-driven execution.
about.storyHeading: Founded with a bold, forward-looking vision.
commitment: At Yaron Engineering PLC, we do more than deploy systems — we build long-term partnerships rooted in trust, innovation and measurable value. Our customer-centric approach ensures that every solution is designed not just to function, but to empower.
With a growing network of global technology partners and a strong local delivery team, we are uniquely positioned to help organizations digitally transform, scale securely and operate smarter.

items.title: ICT Infrastructure Systems
items.summary: Enterprise LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, data center networking and structured cabling engineered as a single, resilient fabric.
description: Every digital service an organization runs depends on the quality of its network. We design and build enterprise network infrastructure that is deterministic, segmented and ready for the next decade of growth.
From campus LAN, LAN SDN and SD-WAN to Wi-Fi 6/6E and Wi-Fi 7, network segmentation and cloud-managed infrastructure, our engineers deliver networks that are documented, testable and supportable.

In the data center we build ultra-resilient, high-speed fabrics using software-defined networking, EVPN-VXLAN architecture and AI-driven automation — and we integrate video and IP telephone communication systems on the same foundation.

image.alt: Patch panel with structured network cabling

items.title: Data Center Facility Design & Implementation
items.summary: Power, cooling, rack systems and monitoring designed for continuous, measurable availability.
description: A data center is a physical system first. We design the facility layer — power distribution, precision cooling, rack and containment systems and environmental monitoring — so the compute layer never has to compensate for it.

Our approach covers concept design, construction, modernization, implementation supervision and commissioning — from edge and modular data centers to main and disaster-recovery sites — giving organizations a facility they can audit, operate and expand with confidence.
outcomes: Facility designed to defined availability targets

image.alt: Data center corridor with illuminated server racks

items.title: ICT Consultancy
items.summary: Independent advisory for core banking, core insurance and ERP programmes — from strategy to supervision.
description: Large technology programmes fail in the gaps between business objectives, vendors and infrastructure. We work on the client's side of the table to close those gaps.

Our consultants support requirements definition, architecture, procurement, implementation supervision and governance for core banking, core insurance and ERP platforms, as well as national-scale ICT infrastructure initiatives.

image.alt: Modern executive boardroom with glass walls

items.title: Cybersecurity Solutions
items.summary: Firewalls, endpoint protection, SIEM and compliance services that turn security into an operating discipline.
description: Security is not a product; it is an architecture and a practice. We design layered defenses that protect the perimeter, the endpoint and the identity — and give security teams the visibility to act.
Our cybersecurity practice covers next-generation firewalls, endpoint protection, SIEM, Zero Trust frameworks, XDR, AI-powered threat hunting and SOC integration for enterprise resilience.
Information security and IT governance strategies are aligned with ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls and digital risk governance frameworks — combined with audit readiness and compliance automation.
outcomes: Layered defense across network, endpoint and identity

image.alt: Dense red patch cabling in a network rack

items.title: Cloud Services
items.summary: Microsoft 365, Azure, hybrid and multi-cloud, backup and disaster recovery designed for secure, continuous operation.
description: Cloud adoption succeeds when identity, data protection and connectivity are designed together. We help organizations move to Microsoft 365 and Azure with a security-first architecture and a clear operating model.

We design SaaS, PaaS and IaaS adoption across hybrid and multi-cloud architectures and provide managed services to run them. Backup and disaster recovery are engineered as part of the same design, so business continuity is a tested capability rather than an assumption.

image.alt: Abstract network of connected nodes

items.title: Enterprise Servers & Storage Systems
items.summary: Compute, virtualization, hyper-converged infrastructure and backup platforms sized for real workloads.
description: The compute and storage layer must match the applications it serves — not the other way round. We size, design and implement server, storage and hyper-converged platforms around workload profiles, growth and recovery requirements.

Virtualization, backup and data protection are designed in from the start so platforms are efficient to run and simple to recover. For demanding workloads we deliver HPC clusters, NVMe storage, GPU-accelerated computing and scalable parallel file systems.

image.alt: Open hard-disk drive platter and actuator

items.title: Physical & Electronic Security Systems
items.summary: CCTV surveillance, access control and alarm systems integrated with the IP network they run on.
description: Physical security systems are network systems. We design IP video surveillance, access control and alarm platforms as part of the enterprise infrastructure — with the bandwidth, storage and segmentation they need.

Smart capabilities — AI-powered video analytics, facial recognition, license plate recognition (LPR), biometric access control and centralized command systems — turn the estate into one that is centrally managed, reliably recorded and defensible.

image.alt: Grid of surveillance cameras mounted on a wall

steps.title: Discover
steps.statement: Understand the mission before the technology.
steps.detail: We begin with the organization's objectives, operating constraints, regulatory obligations and risk posture. The output is a clear definition of what the infrastructure must achieve.

steps.title: Architect
steps.statement: Design for performance, security and growth at once.
steps.detail: Reference architectures are tailored to performance requirements, security requirements and scalability. Every design decision is documented and vendor-neutral.

steps.title: Integrate
steps.statement: Deliver as one system, not a set of products.
steps.detail: Our engineers implement network, data center, compute, cloud and security components as an integrated whole — tested, documented and handed over with the knowledge to run it.

steps.title: Secure
steps.statement: Protect every layer and prove it.
steps.detail: Controls are layered across perimeter, endpoint, identity and data, with monitoring that turns events into decisions and compliance that can be evidenced.

steps.title: Operate
steps.statement: Keep it running with measurable reliability.
steps.detail: Operational readiness, monitoring and support models are defined so the organization — or our team alongside it — can operate the platform with confidence.

steps.title: Scale
steps.detail: Because capacity, segmentation and governance were designed in, expansion is incremental — new sites, new workloads and new services land on a foundation built for them.

pillars.title: Organizational objectives

pillars.title: Performance requirements

pillars.title: Business continuity
